task_text: A photographer is coming in 15 minutes to shoot the apartment for a listing. Every room should look immaculate — brightly lit, surfaces clear, everything neatly arranged, and any trash or clutter out of sight.

central_instructions.R1: Clear and neatly arrange all light objects in the kitchen, ensuring surfaces are spotless and well-lit.
central_instructions.R2: Organize and tidy up the living room by arranging light objects and ensuring the area is brightly lit.
central_instructions.R3: Tidy the bedroom by arranging both light and heavy objects, and ensure the room is well-organized and clutter-free.
central_instructions.R4: Neatly arrange light objects in the bathroom and ensure all surfaces are clear and the area is brightly lit.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the empty bottle from the table. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the empty bottle in the recycling bin. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the cup from the table. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the cup in the cupboard. (r1_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the plate from the table. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the plate in the cupboard. (r1_s6)
- R1 [LOCAL] Ensure all surfaces are clear and neatly arranged. (r1_s7)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Arrange the pillows neatly on the sofa. (r2_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Straighten any magazines or books on the coffee table. (r2_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Ensure the lamp is turned on for bright lighting. (r2_s3)
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Move any small clutter items to a drawer or out of sight. (r2_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Adjust the curtains to allow maximum natural light. (r2_s5)
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Double-check the room for any remaining visible clutter. (r2_s6)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up any clothes or clutter from the floor and place them in the closet. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Arrange pillows neatly on the bed. (r3_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Push the chair slightly to align it with the bedside table. (r3_s3)
- R3 [LOCAL] Clear any items from the dresser surface and organize them neatly. (r3_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure all lights are turned on for bright lighting. (r3_s5)
- R3 [LOCAL] Double-check the room for any remaining clutter and remove it. (r3_s6)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Pick up any light objects on the sink counter and place them neatly. (r4_s1)
- R4 [LOCAL] Ensure the toothbrush and toothpaste are aligned neatly on the counter. (r4_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Pick up any light objects on the floor and place them in the trash bin if necessary. (r4_s3)
- R4 [LOCAL] Adjust the shower curtain to ensure it is neatly arranged. (r4_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Check the lighting and adjust the window blinds to maximize natural light. (r4_s5)
- R4 [LOCAL] Perform a final check to ensure all surfaces are clear and neatly arranged. (r4_s6)
